facilities.source: Campspot park record (parkFeatures: Beach, Dump Station, Fishing, Garbage, Playground; no showers or laundry listed) + Campspot reviews (Sept 2026: 'Would be nice to have showers/ bathroom house'; Aug 2026: 'The pit toilets are clean'), read 2026-10-25. values.note: Books only through the Campspot marketplace (the park has no /book/ engine page). Full refund 7+ days out, 50% at 3-6 days, none under 3 days. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.campspot.com/park/nahma-lakeside-landing-campground-and-lodging-llc-nahma-mi + Campspot park record (Cancellation Policy; Terms: 'Check-In: 2:00 PM; Check-Out: 11:00 AM'), read 2026-10-25

note: Campground and cabins at 13723 Main St in the old sawmill town of Nahma, built on the mill slips that open onto Big Bay de Noc (Lake Michigan) beside the mouth of the Sturgeon River; most sites are on the water, with a boat ramp and rentals. Open May to October. Founded in 1997 as No-Nah-Ma Resort and sold in 2025 (Iron Mountain Daily News); it has no website of its own and books through the Campspot marketplace as Nahma Lakeside Landing Campground and Lodging LLC. Not listed on RV Life; Campspot reviewers give it 4.7 (42 reviews, 2026), one reporting low voltage (86-99 V) daily in September 2026. --Claude
summary: Campspot marketplace + API (park 5621): $35 Water + Electric RV Site for 2027 (confirmed; 3% park fee, Campspot booking fee), 49 back-in 20/30-amp water/electric sites open to Class C motorhomes up to 55 ft (count/length/30-amp new, water confirmed), 5 cabins, dump station (confirmed); showers and laundry cleared (derived from the old resort note; the new owners' listing names neither and a Sept 2026 review asks for a shower house). Reservable on Campspot (confirmed; url = the marketplace page, no /book/ engine). Price gate: $36.05 with the mandatory 3% fee, under US$50. Presence: a live Campspot booking engine with a phone and 42 reviews. Not seasonal in character (all 49 sites sold nightly). Season left as derived (no statement). Note's site-count/amp restatement trimmed, review figures updated.
